tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and lie at H=0.16–0.48, far below the target H=24.3. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the gain reverses and constrains its magnitude where the forecast will be evaluated.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term is approximately proportional to H, so its amplitude and time constant can trade off while giving very different forecasts at H=24.3.
A single rising mode could explain the positive pilot gains but cannot represent a delayed sign reversal.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test the response near the forecast horizon.
It does not constrain the slow adaptation or the long-horizon sign.
